status: Preregistered policy/data proposal before any CSP model outcomes; parent review and immutable source tag required before launch. This record does not itself authorize inference.
scope: Separate exploratory CSP study after primary900, supplemental80, and all45 frozen throughput cohorts. Existing studies untouched; no pooling.

schedule.unit: One complete split x all profile arms x seed cohort per invocation; no task/arm subset arguments.
schedule.time_gate: Parent starts only whole balanced cohorts when remaining night permits; extension launch based on time/resources, never failed-task filtering or outcome-based escalation. Partial interrupted cohorts remain explicitly incomplete.
schedule.slots: Four endpoint-owned persistent case slots; all arms of a task run sequentially on its slot. No simultaneous cases per endpoint.
schedule.rotation: Tasks sorted by ID, rotated by seed-1 and reversed for even seeds; arms reversed for even seeds then rotated by task index+seed-1. Tasks assigned round-robin to four slots.
schedule.start_gate: reference_worker.verify_gate(gate_root) verifies original900+80 and final45 throughput cohorts; all4 endpoints must be idle. Parent separately verifies live Docker/model identities before first CSP cohort.
schedule.whole_batch: No controller early-success cancellation. Worker charges and completes all dispatched siblings before stopping; whole-case deadline remains binding.

corpus.evaluation_design: 24/40/64 vertices x3/4 colors x20/40 percent eligible-edge density, full factorial. Balanced planted classes, fixed-count cross-class edges conditioned on connectivity.
corpus.information_boundary: Worker loads only public task data. Reference witnesses and generation metadata never enter prompts. Public seed permits independent reproduction: untouched evaluation, not cryptographically hidden.
limitations: Twelve task clusters only; seeds are repeats, not new independent graphs.
Planted connected distribution, no hardness guarantee or isomorphism screening.
No new harder benchmark is generated in response to these outcomes under this protocol.

model.seed_scope: Deterministic request seeds derived by existing Client from replication seed, agent, stage and prompt; exact repeat determinism is not assumed.

policy_semantics.ranking: Valid-schema first, then fewer exact conflicts, then earliest candidate index. Population survivors retain duplicates; every duplicate is charged.
policy_semantics.parallel_repair4: Four separate own-history chains, one candidate per chain per round.
policy_semantics.evolution4: Initial4 then rounds of2 mutations,1 crossover,1 fresh immigrant. Mutation parents are best and second valid population entries (fallback best). Crossover uses best2 distinct valid assignment hashes; if unavailable, one-parent mutation or fresh. Keep best4 from old+new including duplicates.
policy_semantics.evolution_mutation4: Same as evolution4 except crossover slot always uses best-valid single-parent mutation or fresh; directly paired ablation.
policy_semantics.review_elites4: Initial4; each round two worse population-member candidates review top2 (two same-model calls), then top2 repair using own exact feedback and usable critiques (two calls). Retain best4 old+new.16calls=>10assignment candidates+6reviews;64=>34+30. Invalid critiques are charged and not forwarded. Candidate role delegation, not persistent distinct model personalities.
policy_semantics.democracy4: Initial4 then four repairs per round from own prior assignment and mechanically derived consensus. Invalid candidates excluded; if none valid, fresh proposals. Consensus checked after each unsolved batch, including final batch.
policy_semantics.weighted_democracy4: Same consensus method with exact Fraction weight1/(1+conflicts) per valid candidate.
policy_semantics.color_symmetry: Align candidate labels to best candidate over all k! permutations maximizing agreement; lexicographically first maximizing permutation. Per-vertex vote ties prefer anchor color, then smallest color.
policy_semantics.derived_candidates: Consensus is a derived zero-model-call proposal and is explicitly counted and verified; never claimed as a sampled model solution.
policy_semantics.feedback: Only public graph, previous allowed candidates, exact full-constraint validation/conflicts and same-model critiques. No next-move solver, reference witness or stronger-model advice. Mechanical fitness feedback is an oracle for constraint checking, not unaided self-reflection.

validation_and_accounting.success: Exact full vertex-count/domain/edge verification; independently replay candidate payloads before accepting row. No model-declared correctness.
validation_and_accounting.budgets: All model calls including critiques share call/output reservation ceilings. Input/output tokens separate; identical ceilings do not imply equal realized GPU cost.
validation_and_accounting.cost: Before/after endpoint counters under exclusive case ownership, final idle drain. Missing costs remain null; unfinished client usage is a lower bound.
validation_and_accounting.faults: Stop dispatch after transport/controller/idle/source faults; already running bounded cases finish and drain. Valid controlled deadlines remain task failures or previously proven successes, not infrastructure errors.
validation_and_accounting.integrity: Capture frozen Git revision and source/data/runtime/selection SHA before and after; no overwrite/resume. Raw events/stdout/stderr retained; summary JSON/CSV replaced atomically.
validation_and_accounting.statistics: Task-clustered estimates across seeds. Separately report each recipe, review/derived/model candidate counts, duplicates, valid schemas and stagnation.
validation_and_accounting.curves: Verified success against wall time, dispatched model calls and measured input/output usage; checkpoints4/8/16/32/64 where applicable. Derived votes reported separately.
validation_and_accounting.claim_limit: 100 percent means the finite exact-verifier suite only, never a general guarantee.

zero_llm_reference.status: Implementation and10 authored tiny-graph tests complete before any CSP model outcomes; no corpus results yet. Parent review and common immutable source freeze required before launch.

genetic.implementation: Private verifier-bound clone of existing csp_search.classical_search bytecode; sampling/selection unchanged.
genetic.operators: Two-way fitness tournaments, uniform crossover, one-vertex recoloring, four elites and one fresh immigrant.

random_assignment.sampling: Uniform independent color per vertex; fixed seed.
random_assignment.stopping: Exactly16 scored assignments including duplicates and assignments after a verified solution, unless wall budget expires.

min_conflicts.evaluation_accounting: Score every color including the current color with full assignment fitness. Choose a conflicted vertex uniformly, then choose uniformly among minimum-conflict colors. Count every score.

zero_llm_reference.scope: Separate CPU-search references with different primitive evaluation budgets, not matched LLM-call controls. No CPU evaluation equals a model call. Report evaluations, elapsed CPU/wall time and deadlines.
zero_llm_reference.worker_boundary: No baseline assignments, reference witnesses or next moves enter model workers.
zero_llm_reference.start_gate: Separate plan-first CPU runner calls reference_worker.verify_gate(gate_root) on --run; no corpus run during implementation.
zero_llm_reference.execution: Serial cases; default/--plan writes nothing. --run gates original study, requires a new output directory and preserves full JSON/CSV results.
zero_llm_reference.final_verification: Full final assignment check counted separately from fitness evaluations; goals first verified after deadline do not count as in-budget successes.

final_source_freeze: Runner/tests must pass parent review before commit/tag. Selection excludes its own hash; cohort metadata separately captures its SHA plus complete frozen source hashes and Git revision.
